title: Rejecting Work Inequality: Women Say “No” to Unequal Workloads or Unequal Earnings?
eligible_reason: Preregistered online experiment (ultimatum game and norm-elicitation survey) with randomized treatments; OLS of rejection on workload/pay treatments and interactions. No panel DiD design; the 'difference-in-differences' in the text is a between-treatment contrast.
design_notes: master.do: reg rejpay_ workload treatment Inter_Workload_Treatment [demographics] if disadv_share==1 & nationality==1, cluster(q261).
data_files_note: Experimental data, Qualtrics files and preregistration shipped.
